analyst.summary: Tube Investments looks like an auto-components/EV story on the label but on a consolidated basis is roughly half a bet on its majority-owned CG Power subsidiary's power-equipment capex cycle. FY26 revenue grew a healthy 17%, but consolidated profit grew only about 6% once a volatile Q4 tax rate and softness in the Hyundai-linked auto-parts business are stripped out. Balance sheet and cash generation are excellent and the EV-truck business is gaining real share, but at ~85-89x earnings the stock needs several growth engines to keep firing together with little room for disappointment. Hold.
